tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Neckar ink. The brand's dark: app icon tile, banners, social backgrounds, the selected switch. Page background in dark mode.

tokens.name: gruen
tokens.usage: Grün. The route colour: the logo route, the GrünRoute line on maps, dots and live markers. Graphics and large type only; on white it is 3.4:1, so never body text.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Large brand blocks on covers and slides: ink on light, a lifted ink on dark so the block never melts into a dark page.

tokens.name: gruen-text
tokens.usage: Green for text and links on paper or surface (5.0:1 on paper). Swaps to mint in dark.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: The target point in the logo and the accent on ink (10.2:1 on ink): taglines on banners, the selected switch in dark mode.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool, slightly green white, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised things that hold controls: inputs, the active street row, route cards, live values.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders. Rows are split by stone rules, not boxed in cards.

tokens.name: stone-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the switch track, chips at rest, the read first note, score bar track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper and surface (15.3:1).

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Secondary text: taglines, areas, captions, notes (6.0:1 on paper, 6.3:1 on dark surface).

tokens.name: fix-soon
tokens.usage: Fix score 80 to 100. Data colour only: rank pins, street lines, score bars. Never decoration.

tokens.name: plan-next
tokens.usage: Fix score 50 to 79. Data colour only. White numerals on it pass 4.0:1.

tokens.name: check-later
tokens.usage: Fix score below 50. Data colour only, kept greyer than gruen so it never reads as the brand.

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: Reserved for heat warnings and a heat layer once heat is joined to streets. Not used anywhere else.

tokens.name: weak-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Weak evidence badge.

tokens.name: weak-text
tokens.usage: Text of the Weak evidence badge and the ground check rule (7.5:1 on weak-bg).

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Which street should Heilbronn fix first?
styles.usage: The one question at the top of the home page. 30px on phones.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Fix scores and big figures. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Cooler, cleaner, and safer streets for Heilbronn
styles.usage: Tagline under the headline. 17px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cars pass close, average 77 cm in the ATRAI sample

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: ATRAI sample, not a full city ranking.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gaps in the proof line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones, block gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter on tablets, panel top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop column padding, section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large breaks on banners and posts (posts use 84px margins at 1080px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards that hold content: route cards, live values, notes.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The map frame.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The logo tile: 28 on a 120 grid.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch, chips, badges, buttons.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Header height. Logo and wordmark only.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target.

tokens.name: route-stroke
tokens.usage: Route line width relative to the mark: 18 on a 120 grid.
